hxcombobox.h File Reference

Detailed Description

This file contains definitions for the Hx UI Toolkit combo box widget API.

A combo box is a dropdown box with an editable field.

HxResult HxComboBoxDelete ( HxComboBox_t *  pComboBox  ) 

Delete a combo box widget.

HxComboBoxDelete deletes a combo box created from an earlier call to HxComboBoxNew.

It is not necessary to call this function when quitting the application, since the widget's parent calls this function just before the parent is deleted. HxComboBoxDelete only needs to be called when removing a combo box at runtime.

Parameters:
pComboBox IN: Pointer to the combo box to delete
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful.

HxResult HxComboBoxNew ( uint32_t  id,
HxWidget_t *  pParent,
const HxRectangle_t *  pRect,
const char *const *  hText,
int32_t  count,
HxComboBoxAttributes_t  attributes,
HxComboBox_t **  hComboBox 
)

Create a combo box widget.

HxComboBoxNew creates a new combo box widget.

The height of pRect is the maximum height of the control. Additional strings are accessed by scrolling through the list. HxDropdownBoxGetBounds can be called before creating the combo box in order to pass in an appropriately sized rectangle.

Most of the HxDropdownBox APIs may also be used on HxComboBox_t* objects.

Parameters:
id IN: Unique ID for the widget, defined by app, or kHxWidgetAutoID to auto-generate the ID
pParent IN: Pointer to "parent" widget
pRect IN: Pointer to rectangle describing the position and size of the control
hText IN: Pointer to the array of strings
count IN: Count of strings in hText
attributes IN: Currently, only kHxComboBoxDefault is defined
hComboBox OUT: Handle to the created combo box, NULL on failure
Returns:
HxResult: Returns HX_OK if successful. Returns HX_MEMORY_ERROR if memory allocation fails.
